references.text: Continues the theme of prohibitions against sexual relations with half-sisters, specifically the nakedness of a father's daughter
Specifies the punishment for one who takes his sister, whether a father's daughter or a mother's daughter, and uncovers her nakedness
A curse is pronounced on anyone who lies with his sister, whether a father's or a mother's daughter
Amnon's sin against his half-sister Tamar illustrates the violation of this prohibition
The prophet Ezekiel condemns Jerusalem because men have violated their sisters, their father's daughters
